rv.q: First Date goes for it. And it works.
Anyone who has ever been "fixed-up" for a date will get a kick out of watching this 100 minute ( no intermission) musical comedy that employs a cast of five plus a piano player.

cn.t: Critics praise this sweet, funny rom-com for embracing cringe-worthy dating moments and finding the perfect fit in Oil Lamp Theater's intimate space, delivering quality entertainment with genuine laughs and heart.
